Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Master's degree in a relevant food science or scientific field.

  • Active SQF or HACCP certifications.

  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled R&D tools to drive data analysis, ingredient screening, or workflow efficiency.

  • Strong professional communication skills with comfortable, executive-level customer-facing presence.
